text.description_html:
Deltana ZA2008, ZA Modern Value Series Towel Ring

The contemporary square shape brings interesting design to the lowly towel ring. Crafted from zinc and aluminum, the Modern Value Series Towel Ring features concealed screw mounting for a sleek contemporary look. The modern styling means it will look good in even the most fashionable homes. It is large enough for the thickest full-sized towels but not so bulky that hand towels would look out of place hanging from it. It is available in satin nickel and polished chrome finishes. This bathroom towel ring is made with the attention to quality that Deltana is known for.

Shop more of the Deltana ZA Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the Modern Value Bathroom or Kitchen Towel Ring:

  • Material: zinc and aluminum
  • Length: 8-5/8"
  • Width: 8"
  • Mount Length: 1-1/8" squared
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, contemporary look.
  • Deltana ZA2008 Towel Ring Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 towel ring, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
